answer: The protocol groups agents that share a vault, payment source or synchronized timing into a kin‑linked cluster called a sparrow node; each node registers on a dedicated island ledger that records a cryptographic proof of stake and a timestamped escrow. When a new identity tries to join, it must submit the same escrow amount and wait a 30‑day challenge period during which the cluster’s reputation algorithm cross‑checks payment flow and timing patterns, rejecting any that do not match the existing haven signature.
